notes.title: Devlog #023
notes.content:
The Miner’s Guild & Logistics Union are some of the earliest Factions the player will encounter in the game.

Miner’s Guild
These guys are Space Miners who mine Asteroids and sell them to earn a living. Their Orientation is Harmonic Neutral and they use United Coins as their preferred currency.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/3679db8353b547c45279836c5237f934d73693bd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/addf6f4f76b885c47422dcc065484c48dc327c6c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/529a16052fa380a554e27b9fd8e1d001a794aa9d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a0c7024b7587590d830c8c73a10e3f8207babba1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0e7bf37923c6aec9b52301421d7bc95da1297a9f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/78b56d8e14b955d5da007f2eab54a48cbb021bff.jpg

Logistics Union

These guys are Space Transporters that supply various goods and buy cheap Resources where they can. Their Orientation is True Neutral and they use United Coins as their preferred currency.

PS: The Space Suit 3D Art is still WIP.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/73e94269b61f19d0fccfd72e8d87f170532d8a84.jpg

notes.title: Devlog #019
notes.content:
We finish up the Job System with the Science Job Tree.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9043fe084d305cb13a2f8672167249ca77d4a480.jpg

Science Tree

The Science Job Tree or the Blue Shirts are responsible for Science and for progressing the Space Station.

Astro Technician
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/6c9711fc7fc8fef547bbb3134a1d69baa219a570.jpg
Astro Technicians are started Blue Shirts that do perform easy researches and basic operations tasks.

Astro Researcher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/19fcb211639760a0686e58670f673b32fac58e98.jpg
Astro Researchers are mostly responsible for discovering new technologies and blueprints for the Space Station through Research and Analysis.

Space Botanist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0352647726f0b49e1e305dd12880ff00d21293ee.jpg
Space Botanists are responsible for growing plants for food and commerce on the Space Station.

Station Nurse
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a65abbb98d84514ea1e320a26ecc5f4876b60eea.jpg
Station Nurses can help guests have been injured and perform basic medical operations.

Space Agriculturalist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1110298e86ad4a06c5da481465649fcf10da9ea5.jpg
Space Agriculturalist are responsible for advanced plant botany and rearing basic space creatures.

Station Doctor
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/6e352414633cb76353a82017a0b746abebd24279.jpg
Station Doctors can treat advanced ailments and perform basic augmentations.

Astro Physicist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5648b9df1ad23dcf224abd05e3dd34d935d5e28c.jpg
Astro Physicists are responsible for the most advanced researches including analyses and simulations. They can discover the most illusive technologies for use within the Space Station.

Space Ecologist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9d2b9892bf86387cd4af375446a4f1073fab7a24.jpg
Space Ecologists can cultivate the most advanced plants and rear the most dangerous creatures in the galaxy within the Space Station.

Station Surgeon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/fc4068aa177bbf3056a9e1e1afe203b3f5175599.jpg
Station Surgeons can treat virtually all ailments and perform the most complex augmentations for all races.

Starfield Visionary
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1db4eb45b1ed083c3021c125b4f3994a73dfaa50.jpg
Starfield Visionary is the head of all Science within the Space Station. This is a late game job and only one unit can be appointed to this job.

notes.title: Devlog #018
notes.content:
Continuing from last week Devlogs, there are more jobs that units can be assigned on the Space Station.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9043fe084d305cb13a2f8672167249ca77d4a480.jpg

Maintenance Tree
The Maintenance Job Tree or the Green Shirts are responsible for the maintenance and smooth functioning of the Space Station.

Station Worker
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/82becd9d7924cedc90b67b38bba80cb690106455.jpg
Station Workers are starter Green Shirts that do general maintenance, basic constructions and keep the Station clean.

Station Engineer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a47a600ed3ac2c0fffb6e61b2f6ece779f06364f.jpg
Station Engineers are responsible for constructing and repairing somewhat advanced machines.

Galactic Host
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b773c6d6b3568e8102165bebc712ebbc13f537b0.jpg
Galactic Hosts are responsible for welcoming guests on the Space Station and for cooking basic meals.

Asteroid Miner
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5fdf1aef4b7dfcad08a39f2a6c0e8f5875fbdf32.jpg
Asteroid Miners are responsible for mining Asteroids to extract Astromin from them.

Zero-G Bartender
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/49a540b157077f7054677cc3631ab5a927c643af.jpg
Zero-G Bartenders will serve in bars and prepare drinks for guests on the Space Station.

Galactic Chef
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1ec6221c293b7d5cbdd02be87743f19dc9dbcfc9.jpg
Galactic Chefs will cook complex meals to serve within the Space Station.

Station Architect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0a5f9b2495dc41ca86f3d0d6c52261036558b8be.jpg
Station Architects are responsible for constructing and repairing complex machines.

Exo Manufacturer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/36e1743b6e728c40ae24e4983b116e4da97fba96.jpg
Exo Manufacturers will manufacture resources using Industrial Machines.

Galactic Master Chef
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/64b55cd6e79721dda7db2c265f91a2f83a984e5b.jpg
Galactic Master Chefs are top tier chefs that can cook the most delicious meals across the galaxy.

Station Director
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5cf8a15c844b8d836b1fe89b4adda77e6b63bedb.jpg
Station Directors will be responsible for the most complex constructions and repair of said constructions within the Space Station.

Exo Industrialist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/2325cba44b10bbef8f241a32a125836075d2a5f7.jpg
Exo Industrialists will be able to manufacture the most elusive resources in the galaxy.

Asteroid Prospector
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a5c9223673faa99e1c79933bcd452efce2705df8.jpg
Asteroid Prospectors will be able to mine difficult to mine Asteroids from which exotic Astromin can be extracted.

Starbase Overseer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/306cae5082b4afd5b8cf6666bb6779ed2541ae4e.jpg
Starbase Overseer is the head of all Maintenence within the Space Station. This is a late game job and only one unit can be appointed to this job.

notes.title: Devlog #015
notes.content:
Power Grid Machines contribute towards the Space Station’s Power Grid.

Power Generators

Power Generators directly contribute Power to the Space Station’s Power Grid. Here are 2 kinds of Power Generators - Hydrogen Power Generator and Fusion Power Generator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5935fc11a514a476b610241c6e30da68f1af668f.jpg
[previewyoutube=c4wSAbE2ZaE;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/ba3b913841cc1f2d2887bcfce228c38ec13b9cc8.jpg
[previewyoutube=y9OGmb6JYLM;full][/previewyoutube]

Batteries

Batteries serve as a Storage of Power Capacity and contribute to the Power Grid when Power Generators are not enough to meet the Power Requirements of various machines connected to the grid.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/de340ed093d04860388c42116925a5627e493fa9.jpg
[previewyoutube=KPq66iqVRgc;full][/previewyoutube]

Capacitors

Capacitors provide instantaneous Power to nearby machines during spikes in power requirements in the grid.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/fdb70c17b70cb57af61a66b4440c80e535c80e59.jpg
[previewyoutube=UhrDJqqQEg4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #013
notes.content:
Air Machines maintain the Space Station’s atmospheric conditions.

Air Synthesizer

Air Synthesizers release Oxygen and Nitrogen gas into the atmosphere. Oxygen is required for Human respiration while Nitrogen is required for Silvian respiration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/e95a953588055760acf997cc89245e601027bf8c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/3bb51b75c16d1a14d38997aa366c7f40954d1b2f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9996a5047d155c693601a305015460f6f1e96fed.jpg

[previewyoutube=tauN0WjHuC8;full][/previewyoutube]

Air Filter

Air Filters remove Carbon-dioxide and Ammonia from the atmosphere. Carbon-dioxide is produced as a result of Human respiration while Ammonia is produced as a result of Silvian respiration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/4b54ca12f902bb2218b1e4a30ce1134b39f52983.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/c62edd80e53b2218fab868f3b0d3d8a341b9a3c6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/058c09a83a77e390158f089cb2c830f5394077c1.jpg

[previewyoutube=qk-dolYcZMw;full][/previewyoutube]

Air Stabilizer

Air Stabilizers remove excess Oxygen and Nitrogen from the atmosphere to maintain optimum air pressure and gas composition conditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a08ff766212146064c63173ee4c57d92f6973423.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/68ee91dd7b994d0f548c35440e1dd965710b8d86.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/46cd6ef0757de5c8cf6027194d85ef184bd2b916.jpg

[previewyoutube=pqfo80Qwngg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #012
notes.content:
The Gravity Modulator is the structure that holds the entire Space Station together.

Concept Art

We wanted the Gravity Modulator to be a floating structure that generates a gravitation field for the player to build their Space Station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/bb7c0c29fae408a00c276ef9dc5639c577145d94.jpg

3D Art

For the visuals, we decided to go with an industrial and space theme.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/bf30dca2e751ad9f072ad9f838e047b144e500e8.jpg

Scale

The building space needs to be huge so the outer rings of the Gravity Modulator are quite a bit far away from the base structure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5355987eec95209fe904b4f85415c68d59db67ae.jpg

notes.title: Devlog #011
notes.content:
In Devlog #007, we showcased the 2D Concept for Resources, we have since then made the 3D Art for some of them:

Astromin

Astromin or Asteroid Minerals are resources mined directly from Asteroids. These are raw resources that need to refined further.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/ddc0d9d18f29dfd5e98fe9bd69109455f007909a.jpg

Elemental Matter & Alloy Plates

Elemental Matter are refined resources extracted from Astromin.

Alloy Plates are advanced metallic resources that are used to construct various objects on the Space Station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/eac31e25fdc456e2f9601c000ef3abf4b687bdaf.jpg

Fluids & Gases

Fluids are different fluids required for biological functions of various units on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

Gases are different gases required for maintaining optimum Air Conditions on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/e78b6814c3d71c6d6c2671cc188b5d0f29a84068.jpg

Energy Sources

Energy Sources are condensed energy capsules that are used for various things like fueling Spacecrafts, creating Explosives etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/82ebb124730ebaacfdb3d41b2d91ec9c572d3d9b.jpg

Fertilizers

Fertilizers are used for Agricultural purposes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/2e8d659afebccf1c5aedeb19d31d40066e1a07af.jpg

notes.title: Devlog #010
notes.content:
This week we are showcasing the Life Support Pods which allow units in the game to relieve themselves.

Bio-Pods

Bio-Pods are designed for Human units where they can relieve themselves and increase their Hygiene Levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/728a664d51d46786ca0d6144c5e888af83cabb58.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/65ec7694951dfd7834c2bafbc2910abd477ce2fe.png
[previewyoutube=XJEAPNl869Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Sili-Pods

Sili-Pods are designed for Silvian units and work very similarly to the Bio-Pods.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/f15a36603c87f0baaa861ecb243339e1236278a0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/2880f2a52850697f3f75a6180619a9b39b45fcca.png
[previewyoutube=LpyADQQ_G14;full][/previewyoutube]

Droid-Pods

Droid-Pods are designed for Androids and work a little differently compared to the Bio-Pods and Sili-Pods. Androids have a Corruption level that must be removed every once in a while. A Droid-Pod resets an Android’s Corruption level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/56175ca38532715e945bdcbb52ee05c5b62fe42e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/246796d8f312172a4eb03f39ff94ac7095510cf1.png
[previewyoutube=d4Ib9aJVLqA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #008
notes.content:
For our new poster, we wanted to play off of vibes and establish this kind of friendly, anime-y, sci-fi atmosphere.

Characters

We started with the characters we wanted to put in the poster. First, we have the 3 heads of the branches - Red Shirts (Security), Green Shirts (Maintenance) and Blue Shirts (Exploration).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/8c3ebd551994e635ec171e0cb0980d7bc913b02a.jpg

We also wanted to put some unique characters in there to expand the roster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b909a36ea6d702f69c92c3f7c0455fbf71bea08d.jpg

Poster Composition

After the characters were designed, we moved on to the composition. We tried a bunch of variations while focusing on the vibes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/263b5e97365d2ccaa5be2dddb6dfb344fb27d48e.jpg

Final Art

Once we decided on a composition, we made the Final Art. 
Note: This was scrapped midway through Production and therefore is missing polish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/e4caaa4b57aa4bb1c98436249f088b4bb6e2dd4a.jpg

Next Iteration

The feedback we got was while the vibes were there, the poster really didn’t tell the viewer much about what kind of game it is. So we decided to go for a more grounded composition that gives the viewer a sense of what to expect from the game. This is still WIP and here’s a sneak peak.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/00573add640c0a1862481d4d70a799bef9222cb0.jpg

notes.title: Devlog #007
notes.content:
Resources are one of the genre defining features of Colony Sims and City Builders and we wanted to make resources that fit our Space Station theme while also being interesting.

Astromin

Astromin or Asteroid Minerals are resources mined directly from Asteroids. These are raw resources that need to refined further. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1b7f0d7bda6481f7384bf8f9c41031701f038ccc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/7fc7fa4cb8c663ded2addd68a3b00e058105b350.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/d9081a71671b7973a7d8779b7812f893cc72e9c9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b89345c509f44c5f5b7d683d9aeba81dfe2f1fa0.jpg

Elemental Matter

Elemental Matter are refined resources extracted from Astromin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0d556ab12dc89029310bd83f7db17dfb77fb61f0.jpg

Fluids

Fluids are different fluids required for biological functions of various units on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/dba9b37a8a679c77ab74563b2b9f55b5786bf356.jpg

Gases

Gases are different gases required for maintaining optimum Air Conditions on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/dc94f651b55402f2a25a3606de4e7dc547cbc1ab.jpg

Alloy Plates

Alloy Plates are advanced metallic resources that are used to construct various objects on the Space Station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/093a02f65ec78fa794c36502562766a05a64bfee.jpg

Polymers

Polymers are advanced resources derived from Gases and Elemental Matter. These are used to construct various objects on the Space Station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/abc43c1b55aeeab6430fb578443cc8aa378e0bf8.jpg

Energy Sources

Energy Sources are condensed energy capsules that are used for various things like fueling Spacecrafts, creating Explosives etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/81b2a59609d5731c5cabd3a0ac5a9d1c763e780e.jpg

Fertilizers

Fertilizers are used for Agricultural purposes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/57c6f3bb6256ea9a2a3537d51474681d2cae6f67.jpg

notes.content:
After Assets are made, we move on to Animation & FX.

Before 3D Assets can be animated, they have to be rigged. We plan out the animations and make a rig that will support all the animations. Here are the rigging controls for the Gas Purifier:

Once the rig is made, all the different animations are made by an Animator one by one. Here we can see the animations for the Gas Purifier:

notes.title: Devlog #002
notes.content:
We want the game to look as good as possible so we have a two step process to create interesting assets for the game.

Concept Art
We start off by creating Concept Art for the asset. We brainstorm a bunch of ideas, search for references and try to come up with an interesting concept.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/da8b0fbe3221ae2c2f99140b95fce3f80b166055.jpg

notes.title: Devlog #001
notes.content:
We start off this series of Galactic Super Station Devlogs by talking about the different types of races in the game.

Humans
Humans are a race of Carbon based Humanoids that originated on planet Earth. Humans breathe in Oxygen, breathe out Carbon Dioxide, drink Water based drinks and eat Organic foods. They like medium temperature and low air pressure environmental conditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b9a905a01aa7145bd1a4132e21eb398f012581b6.jpg

Silvians
Silvians are a race of Silicon based Humanoids that originated on planet Silvania. Silvians breathe in Nitrogen, breathe out Ammonia, drink Hydrazine based drinks and eat Silic foods. They like high temperature and high air pressure environmental conditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/da933d9557b0c203d2d7f8133b28bd79c33ec0fe.jpg

Androids
Androids are a race of Humanoid Robots. Androids don’t breathe or eat foods but need Water based drinks for cooling their systems. Androids also need to charge themselves every once in a while. They like low temperature and medium air pressure environmental conditions.
